about: Seed points that identify each political region of Base Map - Blue.png. A seed is any SIM_NORMALISED point inside the region; the extractor takes the whole connected land region that contains it, so the geometry comes from the drawn border lines, never from these points. Names were assigned by comparing the region with 'Central World All Territories Nation and Capital.png' and 'Central World Tensura Map with Tick.png'.
sourceImage: Sources of Truth/Source Map/Base Map - Blue.png
